title: agent-capmap waivers
description: Findings a person has decided to accept. Each waiver names one finding by its fingerprint, has an owner and an end date, and stops applying after that date.

fingerprint.description: The `fingerprint` of the finding, from the JSON output. Exact match only: no wildcards.

rule.description: Optional safety check: the rule id the finding must have.

reason.description: Why this finding is accepted. Be specific enough for a reviewer.

owner.description: Who is accountable for this decision.

expires.description: Last day the waiver applies (YYYY-MM-DD). After it, the finding is active again.
